name: security-knowledge
description: Shared security reference packs for consistent mapping across plugins: MITRE ATT&CK/DEF3ND lookup, OWASP Top 10 families (Web/API/LLM/Mobile) and ASVS verification levels, cross-framework control mapping (CWE, NIST CSF/800-53, CIS, ISO 27001), and a per-language secure-coding quick reference.
